studies.title: From mountain snow to river flow
studies.aim: Test how elevation, snowfall and soil-water storage shape seasonal river flow.
studies.image_alt: Observed and simulated monthly runoff in held-out years, arranged consecutively as a study preview.

studies.title: Read the landscape through its stations
studies.aim: Explore how location, elevation and mapped soil texture relate to satellite vegetation and temperature.
studies.image_alt: Actual meteorological station locations, coloured by terrain elevation.

studies.title: Water withdrawals and downstream deliveries
studies.aim: Locate the rivers, compare reported country withdrawals and trace reservoir and Aral delivery records to their sources.
studies.image_alt: Geographic overview of the Amu Darya and Syr Darya basin systems with the river network and selected dams.
studies.detail: 2022–2024 · model diagnostics kept separate · no inferred country outflows

studies.title: River flow without a gauge
studies.region: SYR DARYA & AMU DARYA · 76 CA-DISCHARGE GAUGES
studies.aim: Predict monthly discharge from climate and basin attributes alone, pooled across gauges and validated on gauges withheld from training entirely — then calibrated per gauge where one exists.
studies.image_alt: Log-log scatter of observed versus predicted discharge on gauges the pooled model never trained on, and feature importance, across 76 Syr Darya / Amu Darya gauges.

studies.title: Every reservoir and lake in the basin
studies.region: SYR DARYA & AMU DARYA · 378 SWOT-TRACKED LAKES
studies.aim: Track reservoir and lake surface area and water level from NASA/CNES’s SWOT satellite, basin-wide, without needing any upstream country to share a gauge reading.
studies.image_alt: Map of 378 SWOT-tracked lakes across the Syr Darya / Amu Darya basin, with 6 named reservoirs and the Aral Sea highlighted, and a bar chart of latest versus reference area.
studies.detail: 6 named water bodies incl. the Aral Sea · record since mid-2023

studies.title: Where drought lands, and who downstream feels it
studies.aim: Water-year precipitation, SPI and Palmer drought index for every basin against the 1991–2020 normal and the previous 10, 20 and 30 years, with the upstream supply each Uzbek region depends on.
studies.image_alt: SPI-12 by water year, 1961 to 2025, for the Amu Darya and Syr Darya: brown bars for dry years and teal bars for wet years.
studies.metric_label: Documented dry and wet years found in the data
studies.detail: of 6 · 206 of 438 sub-basins had 4+ severe drought years since 1991

studies.title: What survives testing properly
studies.aim: Mann–Kendall and Sen’s slope for nine variables across every level-12 basin, corrected for persistence and for testing thousands of basins at once.
studies.image_alt: Significant basin counts per variable before correction, after correcting for serial persistence, and after false discovery control.
studies.detail: of 7,445 · soil moisture · four of nine variables retain none
